Name: Coin Icon Replacer
Author: Coludy12
Description:
[b][size=5]ABOUT

[/size][/b]Change Coin Icon in item Value UI (when you cursor on Item/shop item)

This mod perfectly matches with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6686]Hyper Realistic Coins[/url] style
Thanks to undare for allow to use color palette in his mod!


[size=5][b]Config

[/b][/size]You can select coin style in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] 
There are matching items for each style in Hyper Realistic Coins.


﻿Basic_gold → [b][u]Gold
[/u][/b] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿
Flowers_and_rivers_gold → [u][b]Gold(Flowers_and_rivers)[/b][/u]
﻿
Polished → [u][b]Gold(Polished)[/b][/u]

Junimo_gold(rare_gold) → [u][b]Gold(Junimo)[/b][/u]

Refined_silver → [u][b]Silver(Refined)[/b][/u]

Refined_Junimo_silver → [u][b]Silver(Junimo)[/b][/u]

tacos → [u][b]Taco

[/b][/u]
You can see it in mod image page


[size=5][b]Install

[/b][/size]1. Download and Install in Requirements Section
2. Download this mod
3. Unpack inside "StardewValley/mods" folder
4. Run game and choose style in Generic Mod Config Menu


My first mod in my life! YAY!
